summary: Backend CRUD + normalization and full frontend flow (add/search/edit/delete, tel: link, YOU badge, My Cars) tested on external URL. All checks passed.
passed: POST /api/vehicles creates vehicle (201) with id + created_at
POST empty fields returns 422 validation error
GET /api/vehicles returns list sorted by created_at desc, no _id in payload
GET /api/vehicles/{id} returns single vehicle; 404 for missing
PUT /api/vehicles/{id} updates fields; plate collision returns 409
Frontend loads with Shiv Sampada header, Search/Directory/My Cars tabs, search input
Add dialog opens with 4 inputs (owner, phone, flat, vehicle)
Submitting valid vehicle closes dialog; card appears in Directory with plate/owner/flat and tel:+91... Call button
Duplicate plate (space/lower variant) shows error toast
Search tab partial search (case/space insensitive) filters correctly; Clear button works
Owned card shows YOU badge, Edit and Delete buttons (localStorage tracking)
Edit dialog pre-fills and saves updates
Delete AlertDialog confirms and removes card
My Cars tab shows only browser-owned vehicles
